title: 尼泊尔洪灾重建或需50亿美元
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Officials in Nepal say more than 1,200 people are still missing after this week's devastating flash flood near the Chinese border.
segments.zh: 尼泊尔官员表示，本周靠近中国边境的突发山洪已致超过1200人失踪。

segments.en: That figure includes hundreds of foreign visitors.
segments.zh: 其中包括数百名外国游客。

segments.en: More than 460 people are confirmed dead after a wall of water and debris, rush down a mountain valley, smashing buildings and bridges and burying villages.
segments.zh: 已确认超过460人遇难，洪水夹杂碎石冲下山谷，摧毁建筑和桥梁，掩埋村庄。

segments.en: It is believed the disaster was triggered by the collapse of a glacier in the Himalayan region.
segments.zh: 据信，这场灾难是由喜马拉雅地区冰川崩塌引发的。

segments.en: I think that's exclusively Nepal's only billionaire Benot Chaudhary Chaman and President at Chaudhary Group.
segments.zh: 我想那是尼泊尔唯一的亿万富翁，乔杜里集团总裁比诺特·乔杜里。

segments.en: It is Nepal's largest and most diversified conglomerate.
segments.zh: 这是尼泊尔规模最大、最多元化的企业集团。

segments.en: Benot, our thoughts are with Nepal right now.
segments.zh: 比诺特，我们此刻心系尼泊尔。

segments.en: Talk to us about the emergency efforts on the way.
segments.zh: 请谈谈正在进行的紧急救援工作。

segments.en: Are there gaps that worry you the most? Well, I do know that Nepal was not prepared at all for another after 2015.
segments.zh: 有哪些缺口最让你担忧？我确实知道，尼泊尔在2015年之后对如此规模的灾难毫无准备。

segments.en: Calamity of this scale, we believe that the numbers are yet coming in and we believe that the numbers could pretty much run over 5,000 people.
segments.zh: 我们认为数字还在陆续统计中，最终可能远超5000人。

segments.en: Number of villages have been washed away.
Many, many of the sadly, many of the tourists who were traveling to the Mansur River and Kalas across the world have also been impacted.
segments.zh: 遗憾的是，许多前往曼苏尔河和卡拉斯河的游客也受到了影响。
